title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui says placedActions is drawn, with an eval (#29951)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4xjiquevJqfBXiUoqfQwa1)_

Refs #29951

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：`objectstack-ui` 技能的 `rules/pages.md` 里，`page:header` 那一行去掉了 `placedActions: true` 的“not drawn yet”限定语；`evals/record-page.json` 新增一个评测，考 `placedActions: true` 的用法。
- 为什么改：#29951 的 ui 半边（#30097，已合并）让控制台页头真正读这个键了，#30028 当时写下的限定语和“等渲染器落地再补评测”的说明到这里兑现。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文本和评测，不改代码和 spec。`pages.md` 在 token 上限处，改后 5668/5669，没有变长。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` 一行，`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` 新增的第 3 个用例。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 `pages.md is 5668 tokens (ceiling 5669)`、整体通过。
- 需要你做的：`skills/**` 是受管文件（Tier H），请你复核后批准合并。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`: the component catalogue's `page:header` row now reads `` `placedActions: true` (all placed, read live) `` in place of `(all placed; not drawn yet)`. The console's header renderer reads the key since #30097 (`PageHeaderActions`, through `placedHeaderActions`), so the qualifier #30028 wrote is dropped. This is the sixth of the six qualifiers #30028 listed; #30097 dropped the other five.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json`: a third case. The prompt asks for a custom `kind: 'full'` account record page whose header shows every action packages place on `account`, without listing ids. The expected answer keeps the page and its tab strip and sets `{ type: 'page:header', properties: { placedActions: true } }`, with no `actions` id list beside it (the two are refused together). Assertions: must contain `placedActions: true` and `page:header`; must not contain `slots.tabs` or `actions: ['`.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md`: the `record-page.json` line names the new case.
- Changeset `.changeset/29951-skills-placed-actions-drawn.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Why

#30028's Skills-docs line deferred both pieces to the reader: "no eval exercises it while no renderer reads it, so the eval and the qualifier drop ride with the reader." The reader landed in #30097. The seat split this Tier H file out of #30097 so that PR could land through the queue.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0; `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md is 5668 tokens (ceiling 5669; headroom 1)`, so the row costs one token less than before.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this diff: 42 commands, all run under `os-verify-lock` (VERDICT command-exit 0), every one exit 0; `--ran`: 42 derived, 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. They include the token ratchet and its self-test, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync` and `check:skill-identifier-liveness`.
- The branch is `main` at a52761fdd7 (the #30097 squash) merged in, plus this one commit; `git diff origin/main` before the commit was empty.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No TypeScript changed; CI's `pnpm lint` covers the tree.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English, except the `## 维护者速读` block, which is written in Chinese for the maintainer.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
